description: A British woman in her fifties, bright fluttering voice, quick and breathless, delighted and anxious in the same sentence, comic matriarch, RP with a countryside warmth, speaks fast and rises at the end of phrases.
text: There you are. The Bingleys' carriage has been past twice this morning, and you are still not dressed for anything. Netherfield gives a ball tonight. The whole county will be there, and, I am told, a gentleman with ten thousand a year who has not yet learned to be bored. Do not look at me like that, Arabella. A mother may hope.
